I always cry when I am sad.
I am sad because I am crying.
content.answer: I always cry when I am sad.

content.answer: I usually sweep the garden after the rain.

options: I am using the desktop today because my laptop is not booting up.

I use the laptop when my desktop was not booting up.
content.answer: I am using the desktop today because my laptop is not booting up.

options: I drive to work because I got up late.
I am driving to work today because I was late getting up.
I drive to work after I am late getting up.
content.answer: I am driving to work today because I was late getting up.

content.question: Can you use PowerPoint for a presentation?
options: Yes, I use power point. In fact, I am always using power point for my presentations.
Yes, I do. I always used power point for my presentations.
Yes I can. In fact, I always use power point for my presentations.
content.answer: Yes I can. In fact, I always use power point for my presentations.

content.question: Can she scan a document on both sides?
options: Yes, she scans. In fact, she always scanned documents on both sides.
Yes, she can. In fact, she often scans documents on both sides.
Yes, she does. In fact, she is always scanning documents on both sides.
content.answer: Yes, she can. In fact, she often scans documents on both sides.

content.question: Can you help us organize the auditorium for the seminar this evening?
options: I’m afraid I can’t. I have to get the participant list ready.
I’m afraid I was not available to help. I have to get the participant list ready.
I’m afraid I’m not helping. Because I have to help with the participant list.
content.answer: I’m afraid I can’t. I have to get the participant list ready.

content.question: Can your secretary assist us in getting the registration forms ready for the seminar?
options: I’m afraid she will not able to help. Because she has to do hall arrangements.
I’m afraid she can’t. She has to see to the hall arrangements and the head table.
I’m afraid she won’t. She has to staple the participants’ folders.
content.answer: I’m afraid she can’t. She has to see to the hall arrangements and the head table.

content.question: What happened to your leg?
options: I sprained it yesterday when I fell over a concrete block.
I sprain it yesterday after falling over a concrete block.
I am spraining a ligament yesterday after I fell on a concrete block.
content.answer: I sprained it yesterday when I fell over a concrete block.

content.question: Why is her hand in a plaster cast?
options: She broked her forearm when she tried to shift the inverter motor last week.
She broke her forearm while trying to shift the inverter motor last week.
She had broke her forearm when she was shifting the inverter motor last week.
content.answer: She broke her forearm while trying to shift the inverter motor last week.

content.question: Why is the mechanic absent today?
options: He is absent because the forklift was bruising his toes two days ago.
He is absent because the forklift bruised his toes two days ago.
He is absent because the forklift bruises his toes two days ago.
content.answer: He is absent because the forklift bruised his toes two days ago.

content.question: Why is the welder absent today?
options: He is absent because the angle grinder was lacerating his fingers yesterday morning.
He is absent because the angle grinder had lacerates his fingers yesterday morning.
He is absent because the angle grinder lacerated his fingers yesterday morning.
content.answer: He is absent because the angle grinder lacerated his fingers yesterday morning.

I might compile it on Friday or I might compile it next week. I really don’t know yet. I just have to wait and see.
content.answer: I might compile it on Friday or I might compile it next week. I really don’t know yet. I just have to wait and see.

content.question: When are you going to renew your license?
options: I might renew it tomorrow or I might renew it the day after. I really don’t know yet. I just have to wait and see.
I might renewed it tomorrow or I might renewed it the day after. I really don’t know yet. I just have to wait and see.
I might be renewing it tomorrow or I might be renewing it the day after. I really don’t know yet. I just have to wait and see.
content.answer: I might renew it tomorrow or I might renew it the day after. I really don’t know yet. I just have to wait and see.

content.question: What do you like to do on weekends?
options: I like doing gardening. I usually do in the mornings, but today I’m doing in the evening.
I like to do some gardening. I usually do it in the morning, but today I’m going to do it in the evening.
I like doing the garden. I usually do it morning time, but today I’m doing evening time.
content.answer: I like to do some gardening. I usually do it in the morning, but today I’m going to do it in the evening.

content.question: What do you like to do after work?
options: I like to be doing reading. I’m usually reading fiction, but today I’m reading a biography.
I like to read a good book. I usually read fiction, but today I’m going to read a biography.
I like to do reading a good book. I usually read fiction, but today I’m going to read a biography.
content.answer: I like to read a good book. I usually read fiction, but today I’m going to read a biography.

content.question: What was the main safety failure that led to the incident?
content.answer: Work continued without checking floor conditions.

The operator ignored emergency instructions

content.question: Why was the supervisor partly responsible for the accident?
content.answer: The supervisor allowed work to go on, even with the wet floor.
options: The supervisor caused the floor to become wet
The supervisor failed to report the incident immediately
The supervisor allowed work to go on, even with the wet floor.

content.question: What role did training play in the safety issue?

Safety rules were known but not properly followed.

content.question: Which action best shows responsibility by factory staff?
content.answer: Admitting mistakes and apologising for not following regulations.

content.question: What was the most effective immediate response after the accident?

Sending the trainee home
Stopping work and securing the area before restarting production.
